rationale: The Latin anchors *homo liber* (free man), *rusticus* (countryman/rustic), and *colonus* (farmer/settler) point firmly to a sociolegal class of free but low-status rural commoner, which aligns closest with peasant.n.03 among the candidates; the other synsets (niggard, grouch) reflect only later pejorative extensions of "churl" unattested in the Old English legal contexts cited.
